text:
samir.patel: Morning — quick async standup for LarkFleet adoption (renewal in ~3 weeks). What I did: triaged the webhook 502s from last night and confirmed they're originating in the embedding pipeline. Blockers: embedding length mismatch for a subset of users causing rerank failures. Today: coordinate hotfix with Eng + confirm rollout window with CS lead.

leah.cs: CS update — LarkFleet flagged 4 accounts with degraded relevance. They have a renewal call on Mon, so we need a mitigation before EOD Fri. Asked them for sample IDs; they replied with two examples.

diego.eng: Looking. Suspect quantization edge case introduced in v1.2 when older clients send legacy vectors. PR 542 has a guard but needs prod verification. CI green locally; need a targeted canary on their tenant.

samir.patel: Sounds good. Leah, can you share tenant IDs and sample payload? Priya FYI re renewal urgency.

leah.cs: Sending tenant IDs: `tenant:larkfleet-prod`, `tenant:larkfleet-staging`. Sample IDs from customer: `user_989`, `user_1023`. Dropping sample payload as a gist link in email.

diego.eng: Thanks — I'll run a canary. Command I plan: `./deploy_canary --tenant larkfleet-prod --image inference:v1.2-fix --ratio 10%` Will watch latency/accuracy for 30m. Need a thumbs when ready to proceed.

priya.pm: I'll join live monitoring at 14:30 PT and prep a short customer note (what we changed + ETA).

samir.patel: Go ahead with the canary. Leah, please hold the renewal update message to the customer until we have initial canary signals.

leah.cs: Quick excerpt from their logs: ```ERROR: re-rank failed for request id=abc123, reason='embedding length mismatch: expected 768 got 512'``` — looks like an older client is hitting a quantized model path.

diego.eng: That matches my hypothesis. Plan: fallback to float32 path for the tenant when mismatch detected and ship guard in PR. Pushing patch now. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/542 :eyes:

ops-bot: deploy job 98347 for inference:v1.2-fix started by diego.eng at 2024-04-05T20:08:40Z

diego.eng: Canary started (10% traffic). Dashboards: https://console.redwood.io/d/tenant/metrics?tenant=larkfleet-prod — monitoring token throughput, tail latency, and rerank success rate :chart_with_upwards_trend:

leah.cs: LarkFleet ran a quick smoke test against the canary and reports improved relevance on the sample queries. I'll send a CX note summarizing the mitigation and next steps, and update the renewal owner.

samir.patel: Can someone stub a postmortem in case this escalates? Also need code review on PR 542 — @marta.reviews can you take a look?

marta.reviews: Reviewing now, small nit around test coverage — will comment on the PR in a few.

leah.cs: Closing this async check-in for now. Will re-open if we see regressions. Thanks all :thumbsup:
